response.original_title: ジャニーズJr.選抜野球大会2012春
response.overview: A complete broadcast of the Johnny's Entertainment idol sports senbatsu, held at the Tokyo Dome on March 18, 2012 for an audience of 45,000 fans! Over 90 participants from Hey! Sɑy! JUMP, Kis-My-Ft2, Sexy Zone, A.B.C-Z, & Tokyo & Kansai Juniors divide into "J-RED" & "J-WHITE", engaging in a fierce, high-level performance! The tournament went beyond the tradition's classic baseball, & also ranged in soccer, marathon & relay races. Each member's passion & determination shown on their faces as they compete in this must-see event.
